lines.en: I drift along the current, slowly.
Water fills my shell and I move on.

lines.zh: 我喷一口水，滑出去一段。
lines.en: One jet of water and I glide ahead.
The deep dark is familiar to me.
I hug the seabed, the sand is fine.
Tentacles scout first, the shell follows.
I spiral around the reef rock.
Colder water makes my swimming steadier.
I slip between the kelp fronds.
There is light above, I do not go up.

lines.zh: 我的壳比我沉，正好压住水。
lines.en: My shell is heavy and holds me down.

lines.zh: 一伸一缩，我就走了很远。
lines.en: Push and pull, and I cover ground.
The current pushes, I go with it.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，水纹是旋的。
lines.en: The water behind me curls in spirals.
Sand slips beneath my shell, lightly.
I sink slowly to the trench edge.

lines.zh: 礁石之间，我只认一条路。
lines.en: Among the reefs I keep to one route.
Someone climbs on; I swim as before.
Inside my shell I listen to the sea.

lines.zh: 水压压着我的壳，很舒服。
lines.en: The pressure on my shell feels good.
I count my own tentacles.
I have rested on this rock three days.
No wind down here, only currents.

lines.zh: 我的壳上一圈一圈，都是年岁。
lines.en: Each ring on my shell is a year.
A small fish slips into my shell gap.
I release a few slow bubbles.

lines.zh: 暗处的光，是从我壳上来的。
lines.en: That glow in the dark comes from my shell.
I withdraw, then reach out again.
It is quiet, I need not speak.

lines.zh: 我记不清自己活了多少潮汐。
lines.en: Too many tides to remember.
Water turns one circle inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我张着触手，等吃的自己来。
lines.en: Tentacles open, waiting for food to drift in.
You are holding your breath, I can tell.

lines.zh: 你的脚蹼，没有我的触手灵。
lines.en: Your fins are clumsier than my tentacles.
Which sea did you come down from?
I will look, but keep your hands off.
You carry the smell of boats.
My shell faces you, that is courtesy.
Clumsy in water, but bright.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，对着你的眼睛。
lines.en: I turn slowly to meet your eyes.

lines.zh: 你是来抓我的，还是来看我的？
lines.en: Come to catch me, or just to look?
Do not touch my shell opening.

lines.zh: 你的气泡往上跑，我的不动。
lines.en: Your bubbles rise, mine stay.

lines.zh: 我认得你这种两腿的东西。
lines.en: I know your kind, the two-legged sort.

lines.zh: 你眼里有光，像深海里的磷。
lines.en: Your eyes glow like deep-sea phosphor.
I hold here and watch you swim closer.
A crack opened in my shell.
Do not knock on my shell!
I withdrew, and it still hurts.
Water rushed into my shell.
I cannot turn anymore.
That cost me a year of my life.
One of my tentacles is torn.
The pain shut my shell tight.

lines.zh: 壳上挨了一下，海水都晃了。
lines.en: Something struck my shell; the seawater shuddered.
I retreat slowly, do not follow.
That fish in your hand is mine.
I smell blood, it is fish.

lines.zh: 鱼靠近一点，我就靠近一点。
lines.en: Fish closer, me closer.
One fish and you may touch my shell.
All my tentacles are reaching out.
Do not pull back, I am not done.
Raw fish works better than anything.
I follow slowly, fish, do not flee.

lines.zh: 这味道，从很远我就闻到了。
lines.en: I smelled this from far away.
Feed me and I will know you.

lines.zh: 再给一条，我考虑跟你走。
lines.en: One more and I might follow you.

lines.zh: 我的嘴在触手中间，看不见吧。
lines.en: My mouth hides among the tentacles.
A fish in the water, I always know.

lines.zh: 你手抖什么，鱼又不会咬你。
lines.en: Why tremble, the fish will not bite you.
Shell on shell makes a muffled sound.
You struck my spiral.
The sea is wide, yet you crowd me.
I drew back, and the shell held.
Do not shove, my tentacles are soft.
You swam too fast and hit me.
This shell does not crack.
We brushed past and the water churned.
One touch and I spin halfway.
Clear the water, I am rising.

lines.zh: 你的壳纹，和我的是反的。
lines.en: Your shell spirals opposite to mine.

lines.zh: 我们慢慢绕，绕成一个圈。
lines.en: We circle slowly into one ring.
Life underwater is long, no hurry.
My tentacle found yours.

lines.zh: 我们的壳靠在一起，像两块石头。
lines.en: Our shells rest together like two stones.
This stretch of sea will hold us.

lines.zh: 你转过来，我看着你的壳口。
lines.en: Turn, and I face your shell opening.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，水替我们说。
lines.en: We stay silent, the water speaks.

lines.zh: 深海里，能遇上就不容易。
lines.en: In the deep, meeting is rare.
Let us drift a while together.

lines.zh: 这颗小石子，我卷进触手里。
lines.en: I curl this small stone into my tentacle.
Whose shell shard fell? I keep it.
I tuck it into a shell seam.
Bright things are rare down here.
I coil a tentacle around it to look.
Not edible, but pretty.
I carried it a while as I swam.
What falls stays fallen, the sea takes it.
I press it beneath my body.

lines.zh: 海床上的东西，我都翻过。
lines.en: I have turned over everything on this floor.
Something is moving ahead.
Not a fish, too large.
My tentacles pulled back in.
It blocks my current.
I stare, shell opening toward it.
Something about that shadow bothers me.
Something is following me down here.

lines.zh: 我的螺壳转了半圈，就锁定你。
lines.en: My shell turned half a circle; you are marked.

lines.zh: 它的动作太急，不像海里的。
lines.en: Too jerky, not of the sea.
I am ready to jet away.
I circle it, hunting for a gap.
It nears, I withdraw.
I am nimbler than it in water.

lines.zh: 我的触手在试它的距离。
lines.en: My tentacles measure its reach.
No rush, the sea aids me.
It cannot follow my spiral.

lines.zh: 我往深处退，那里它不熟。
lines.en: I sink deeper where it is blind.
I fix its eye without blinking.
It falters, I advance.
The water moves us both.
I ram with my shell.
Tentacles snap in, it recoils.
My shell barely hit, yet it flinched.
The edge of my shell is hard.

lines.zh: 我在它身边转开，它扑空了。
lines.en: I wheel aside, it grabs nothing.

lines.zh: 我喷了一口水，冲它一脸。
lines.en: One jet of water, right at its face.
Touch my shell and I butt.
My blow knocked it askew.

lines.zh: 海底的东西，打架都很慢。
lines.en: Down here, even fights are slow.
I withdraw, it should leave.

lines.zh: 我从深海的水里浮出来。
lines.en: I rise out of the deep water.
The light here is brighter than below.
My shell is still new.
The current brought me to this sea.
I open my eyes, water everywhere.
A cold ocean, just right.
I turn once, learning the place.
My mark stays in the sand.
I release my first bubble.
A boat above, I slip aside.
This sea gains one more nautilus.

lines.zh: 我把触手伸出来，试水温。
lines.en: I reach out to test the water.

lines.zh: 火在水里也烫，我的壳怕。
lines.en: Fire burns even in water, my shell fears it.
I dropped from the surface.
Out of water, I cannot breathe.
The blast filled the water with sand.
An arrow cut through water and struck me.
That light numbs my shell.
I am starving, my tentacles are weak.

lines.zh: 雷打进海里，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning entered the sea, I shuddered.

lines.zh: 水下面没有底，我往下沉。
lines.en: No floor beneath, I keep sinking.
